offering_description.value: Alamo Group designs and manufactures equipment for road and sewer maintenance, vegetation management, and agriculture. It sells machinery and replacement parts to public works agencies, contractors, farmers, and land managers through dealers and directly to some customers. Some operations also rent and repair equipment.

primary_products.value: Street sweepers and snow removal equipment; vacuum trucks and sewer cleaners; excavators; roadside and agricultural mowers; forestry and tree care machinery

primary_services.value: Equipment rental; equipment maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: Public works contractors, utilities, farms, landscaping contractors, and forestry operators; B2G: Municipal public works departments and state and local transportation agencies

end_markets.value: Road and street maintenance; sewer and utility maintenance; construction; agriculture; forestry and land management

revenue_model.value: product sales: New machinery, attachments, and replacement parts; rental or leasing: Short-term use of specialty equipment such as vacuum trucks; service fees: Equipment maintenance and repairs
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds machinery and attachments from metal and purchased components for dealers, public agencies, and commercial operators; service provider: Supplies rental equipment and services machinery for contractors and public works fleets

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Brazil, and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: Road and sewer maintenance equipment, excavators, mowing and land clearing machinery, and agricultural implements

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent industrial and agricultural equipment dealers and distributors; direct sales: Direct orders and bids from public agencies and commercial fleets; own locations: Company-operated rental and service centers for selected equipment lines
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Workplace safety, environmental and equipment emissions rules, and motor vehicle safety standards for road-going equipment

notes: The current ranking of product lines and the extent of rental and repair services across the group are uncertain.
